steps.what: Identify the actual child, planned procedure and relevant preoperative test/examination episodes in the clinical record {OPS_SYSTEM}, checking patient and observation dates.
inputs: Actual patient, proposed procedure and existing test/examination records
outputs: Actual selected patient and preoperative source episodes

steps.what: Assemble the selected actual existing preoperative test values and examination-report links into the working review panel using native {OPS_SYSTEM} patient/date filters and exact field links.
inputs: Actual existing laboratory, imaging and physical-examination records
outputs: Draft preoperative review panel with dates, units and source links

steps.what: Interpret the actual results of preoperative tests and physical examinations, reading the original reports, checking dates and limitations and deciding their significance for the child's proposed surgery.
inputs: Actual child and surgical context from s1
outputs: Actual human preoperative interpretation and unresolved concerns

steps.what: Write the actual preoperative interpretation and limitations in the clinical note {OPS_SYSTEM}; the native note format supplies only fixed headings, leaving all new clinical findings and judgement to the surgeon.
inputs: Actual interpretation and concerns from s3
outputs: Actual written preoperative interpretation note

steps.what: Save the actual interpretation note in the same {OPS_SYSTEM} patient record.
outputs: Saved actual preoperative interpretation

tasks.design: Use exact native panel assembly and a minimal note-heading template. Actual interpretation remains wholly human and the note write is separate. Existing laboratories, radiology services and examining clinicians produce the actual source records through their unchanged care workflows; no new data collection or autonomous clearance is proposed. Ordinary note save is small, fully retained and ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: A surgeon may manually gather existing preoperative fields and report links before interpreting them.
tasks.enabler_now: Native patient/date filters and linked fields can assemble that actual review panel.
tasks.still_hard: Age, timing, examination context and incomplete evidence affect what each result means for the child.
tasks.human_edge: Integrate actual findings into a defensible clinical interpretation.

ambition.what: Interpret the existing actual preoperative evidence.

tasks.altitude: Specify source dates and review-panel limitations without encoding a clinical decision.

evidence.claim: Native clinical-record views can assemble actual source fields without interpreting preoperative fitness.

assumptions: Conditional baseline includes actual manual panel assembly and a genuine clinical interpretation note; shares are estimates, not measured care data.
Existing test and examination producers continue unchanged. Their capture and clinical work are not removed or newly required.
All source-gap resolution and original-report interpretation remain in s1/s3; a complete-looking panel is not treated as clinical clearance.
Only 5% of note entry is repeated headings; actual clinical writing remains.
unknowns: Actual review panel and current note format
research_questions: Observe an actual preoperative review and distinguish manual source assembly from clinical interpretation.

already_counted.description: Actual patient/source selection, full interpretation, substantive note entry and ordinary save

incremental.description: Maintain patient/date panel mapping and actual note headings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case is external paper evidence with incompatible panel metadata or a panel already assembled natively; no change is deployed. With actual compatible manual assembly, remove 15 hours of field/link gathering plus 0.95 hour headings, less 1 upkeep hour. All actual interpretation and clinical prose remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage surgical service planning and supplies

steps.what: Determine the actual pediatric surgical procedures, urgency, clinical constraints and required equipment for the service plan.
inputs: Actual surgical cases and clinical/resource requirements
outputs: Actual procedure decisions and service constraints

steps.what: Coordinate the actual theatre, anaesthesia, nursing and other relevant teams about available people, time, beds and equipment, resolving actual service-planning conflicts.
inputs: Actual procedures and constraints from s1
outputs: Actual agreed planning constraints and unresolved conflicts

steps.what: Prepare the actual draft surgery schedule in {OPS_SYSTEM}; native case and resource selection supplies repeated case identifiers, team labels and established theatre fields while the surgeon enters actual choices and constraints.
outputs: Complete actual draft surgical schedule

steps.what: Select the actual required surgical supplies and equipment from available stock and real supplier information, determining actual specifications, quantities and shortages.
inputs: Actual current stock and supplier information
outputs: Actual selected supply items, quantities and supplier terms

steps.what: Prepare the actual supply order draft in {PROCUREMENT}, using native catalogue fields for selected item descriptions, unit prices and standard delivery details while entering actual quantities and clinical justification.
inputs: Actual selected items, quantities and terms from s4
outputs: Complete actual surgical supply-order draft

steps.what: Check the completed actual surgery schedule with the agreed clinical and team constraints, resolving conflicts and authorising that final case/time/resource version for official scheduling.
inputs: Actual clinical and team constraints from s1-s2
outputs: Final version-specific surgical scheduling authorisation or unresolved hold

steps.what: Commit the actual authorised case/time/resource version to the official surgery schedule in {OPS_SYSTEM}, only under the final operational authorisation from s6.
outputs: Actual official surgery schedule update

steps.what: Check the actual completed supply order's technical compatibility, quantities, amount, budget authority, delivery and supplier, authorising that final order under the surgeon's existing purchasing delegation.
outputs: Final version-and-supplier order authorisation or escalation

steps.what: Send the actual final surgical supply order to the supplier through {PROCUREMENT}, only under the version-and-supplier authorisation from s8.
outputs: Actual supplier order

steps.what: Resolve actual subsequent service-plan changes and supply exceptions with the care teams or purchasing contacts, returning changed schedule/order content through the relevant final checks before another commit or send.
inputs: Actual order and exceptions after s9
outputs: Actual coordinated exception decisions and required revisions

steps.what: Check the actual obtained supplies/equipment against the actual order and surgical requirements, identifying missing, damaged or incompatible items after delivery.
inputs: Actual requirements and order from s4-s5
outputs: Actual receipt and compatibility findings

steps.what: Enter the actual receipt or discrepancy findings in the existing {PROCUREMENT} receipt record after the delivered items have been checked.
outputs: Actual receipt/discrepancy entry

tasks.design: Use native selection fields for actual schedule and supply-order drafts, with different cuts reflecting their different repeated fields. Preserve clinical decisions, real team coordination, supply selection, complete final operational checks and actual receipt. The schedule commit and supplier order send are separate consequential actions, each gated on its completed final version. An ordinary receipt write is ungated. No autonomous clinical scheduling choice or purchasing negotiation is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated case/resource fields and selected catalogue details may be typed into separate planning and purchasing drafts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scheduling selectors and procurement catalogue fields can reuse those exact existing facts.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical urgency, actual team readiness and compatible pediatric equipment cannot be settled by field reuse.
tasks.human_edge: Balance the actual clinical and resource needs and resolve service conflicts.

ambition.what: Manage the existing surgical service and required supply cycle.

tasks.altitude: Make the clinical, resource and purchasing constraints explicit before transactions.

evidence.claim: Native case selectors and catalogue fields can reduce exact draft entry without choosing procedures or resolving clinical resource conflicts.

assumptions: Conditional baseline is a surgeon with actual scheduling-entry and delegated supply-order duties; no new management baseline is added for a clinician who only advises.
Actual availability is obtained through s2 and actual supply facts through s4; no free complete team/resource feed is assumed.
Thirty percent of s3 is repeated case/resource fields; forty percent of s5 is actual catalogue/price/delivery fields. New clinical choices, quantities and manual repair remain.
All shares are active-work estimates. Actual team, supplier and receiving services continue unchanged; no other-role saving is claimed.
Changed case/time/resource or order/supplier facts invalidate their respective s6 or s8 authorisation.
unknowns: Actual surgeon permissions, purchasing delegation and native field coverage
research_questions: Trace an actual schedule change and equipment order, timing field entry separately from clinical and team coordination.

already_counted.description: Actual clinical decisions, coordination, retained schedule/order entry, full final checks, separate transactions, exception handling and actual receipt

incremental.description: Maintain actual case/resource selectors and catalogue delivery mappings

approvals.approved_version: Actual completed case/time/resource schedule checked in s6; changes require s6 again
Actual completed supply order and supplier checked in s8 under existing delegation; changes require s8 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case has one-off complex cases and non-catalogue equipment with incompatible existing identifiers; actual entry remains manual and no configuration change is deployed. Compatible repeated fields remove 4.5 hours schedule entry and 4 hours supply-order entry, less 1.5 hours upkeep. All clinical judgement, real coordination, final operational checks and small transactions remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the actual postoperative course and current results in {OPS_SYSTEM} before the follow-up visit; a native patient/episode view removes locating the relevant dated entries only.
inputs: Actual child, postoperative episode and current clinical records
outputs: Actual understood recovery context and relevant source results

steps.what: Make the actual follow-up visit, examine the child and discuss recovery with the child and carers, assessing actual symptoms, healing and postoperative concerns.
outputs: Actual follow-up examination and reported recovery findings

steps.what: Use the actual postoperative blood and imaging test reports with the actual follow-up examination to assess recovery, reading original findings and deciding the clinical significance and follow-up needs.
inputs: Actual examination and recovery findings from s2
Actual available postoperative laboratory and imaging reports
outputs: Actual recovery assessment, clinical concerns and follow-up decisions

steps.what: Write the actual postoperative findings, test interpretation and follow-up decisions into the clinical note {OPS_SYSTEM}; the native note supplies repeated episode labels and headings only.
outputs: Actual postoperative follow-up note

steps.what: Save the actual follow-up note in the same {OPS_SYSTEM} clinical record.
outputs: Saved actual follow-up note

tasks.design: Use native episode navigation and a small note template, while keeping actual visits, examination, test interpretation and clinical follow-up judgement. Existing postoperative blood/imaging services produce the actual reports through their unchanged ordered care workflows; no fresh test result is inferred or newly requested automatically. The actual note write is separate, and its ordinary save has no self-approval gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same postoperative episode labels can be located and re-entered repeatedly around genuine clinical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native episode views and note headings can reuse that exact context.
tasks.still_hard: A child can be clinically unwell despite an apparently reassuring isolated result.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise recovery concerns in the actual child and carers' account.

ambition.what: Monitor the actual existing postoperative recovery.

tasks.altitude: Understand which source dates and episode context must stay visible.

evidence.claim: Native episode views and note headings can reduce navigation and repeated labels without monitoring recovery or interpreting postoperative tests.

assumptions: Conditional workflow includes the actual follow-up note, not a new reporting duty; shares are estimates.
Only 1.5 hours of navigation and 1.4 hours of repeated note labels are removed; all new clinical facts and assessment remain.
Actual laboratory/imaging acquisition and clinical reporting remain unchanged and are not free new sensor capture.
No autonomous patient message, additional test order or medication action is proposed.
unknowns: Current episode-view defaults and actual repeated note fields
research_questions: Observe a follow-up visit and time navigation and repeated labels separately from clinical assessment and new findings.

already_counted.description: Actual clinical review, follow-up visit, test interpretation, substantive note entry and ordinary save

incremental.description: Maintain episode navigation and note-field defaults

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case already selects the relevant episode and supplies note headings, or uses incompatible external records; no change is deployed. Where actual repeated navigation and labels exist, remove 1.5 plus 1.4 hours, less 0.5 hour upkeep. All actual visits, clinical interpretation and new note content remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual existing pediatric surgical history, prior records and relevant results in {OPS_SYSTEM}, checking identity, chronology and sources before preparing the case history.
inputs: Actual patient records and genuine source reports
outputs: Actual selected history sources and identified gaps

steps.what: Clarify the actual case history with the child and carers, checking symptoms, previous procedures and uncertain or conflicting accounts through the actual clinical conversation.
inputs: Actual gaps and sources from s1
outputs: Actual clarified history and explicitly unresolved accounts

steps.what: Capture the actual clarified facts, attribution, negations and unresolved history points in the permitted working note or dictation in {OPS_SYSTEM}.
inputs: Actual selected source facts from s1
outputs: Actual supplied history notes/dictation with source attribution

steps.what: Prepare case histories by drafting the actual pediatric surgical history narrative in {OPS_SYSTEM} from the supplied source records and captured facts, preserving chronology, negation and attribution.
inputs: Actual selected history sources from s1
outputs: Draft source-linked case-history narrative

loop.purpose: Draft a case-history narrative from actual supplied facts
loop.input: Actual selected clinical sources and captured history notes/dictation from s1/s3
loop.output: Draft attributed chronology with explicit gaps and source links
loop.check: Surgeon checks all facts, negation, timing, source attribution and omissions in s6
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved contradictions or unsupported text return to manual composition
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native case-history fields first; actual carer accounts and prior narrative records still require prose assembly rather than exact field mapping.

steps.what: Populate the case history's actual repeated patient/episode identifiers and selected report-reference fields using native {OPS_SYSTEM} links from the already selected actual records.
inputs: Actual selected patient/episode and report records from s1
outputs: Complete draft case history with exact identifiers and source references

steps.what: Check and correct the actual completed case history against the source records and clarified accounts, including patient identity, chronology, negations, attribution and important omissions.
inputs: Actual selected sources and captured facts from s1-s3
outputs: Actual corrected pediatric surgical case history

steps.what: Save the actual corrected case history in the same {OPS_SYSTEM} patient record.
outputs: Saved actual case history

tasks.design: Use native exact field links and a bounded narrative drafting pass from actual records and actually captured history. Conversation and capture remain separate; no ambient recording or free transcript is assumed. Full correction and manual fallback remain counted, and the ordinary same-record save needs no author self-approval gate. No clinical recommendation or external case-history send is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: A case history can require composing actual scattered source facts and re-keying identifiers/reference fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field links and bounded prose drafting can reduce assembly while preserving actual fact checking.
tasks.still_hard: Carer recollection, prior records and current symptoms can disagree in clinically significant ways.
tasks.human_edge: Clarify the history and preserve uncertainty rather than resolve it by fluent wording.

ambition.what: Prepare the existing actual case history.

tasks.altitude: Define chronology and attribution standards for case-history documentation.

evidence.claim: Bounded narrative drafting and native identifier links can assist case-history assembly while actual clarification, capture and clinical correction remain necessary.

assumptions: Actual source records already exist through unchanged care workflows, and actual new conversation/capture is counted in s2-s3.
Conditional baseline manually composes case histories and repeats source-reference fields; shares are unmeasured estimates.
The 60% narrative remainder includes factual repair and manual fallback, with the full separate final fact check retained.
Existing native identifier population earns no new saving; no new recording programme or extra case-history product is added.
unknowns: Actual permitted note workflow and manually repeated fields
Source-record comparability and frequency of conflicting history
research_questions: Test a permitted completed case with contradictory dates and negated symptoms, measuring actual draft repair and final checking.

already_counted.description: Actual source review, history clarification, input capture, retained narrative writing/repair, complete fact correction and ordinary save

incremental.description: Maintain actual case-history field links and sample draft omissions after changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case has conflicting or unusual narrative sources, so all 30 hours of narrative writing remain manual; compatible actual identifier/reference fields can still remove 10 hours, less 2 upkeep. With comparable actual supplied narrative, remove a further 12 hours of assembly from s4, reaching 22 less 2. Conversation, capture and complete final checking remain in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Specify trustworthy clinical-source and operational data while retaining actual pediatric assessment, service decisions and patient/carer conversation.
skills_to_grow: Recognising draft omissions and incompatible clinical context
role.ambitious_version: A pediatric surgeon who reduces proven record assembly and repeated operational fields while keeping clinical interpretation, actual follow-up and consequential service decisions.
